RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel does not prove discrimination, but it heightens the risk of unconscious affinity bias and may breach public-sector recruitment guidelines mandating gender-diverse panels. 

However, the successful candidate possessed relevant international project experience, so the decision may reflect specific role requirements. Levelling allegations of sex discrimination without evidence risks damaging professional relationships.

Take these steps:
1. Follow up firmly on your requested written feedback and scoring matrix.
2. Check your ministry’s HR policy regarding interview panel composition.

If panel diversity rules were violated or the scoring appears inconsistent, raise the composition as a formal procedural issue. Otherwise, evaluate the objective feedback before deciding whether further action is warranted.
